exposure: surgical methods for infertility (laparoscopic techniques, hysteroscopic techniques, laparotomy)
cohort: The study discusses infertile patients, defined as women under 35 years failing to conceive within 12 months or women over 35 years failing to conceive within 6 months.
finding: Surgical methods, encompassing laparoscopic, hysteroscopic techniques, and occasionally laparotomy, remain important for treating specific pathologies causing infertility, even with advances in assisted reproductive technology.
